audit.why: Chart reads Kled,Kled,Skill,Kled,Ambessa,Skill,Kled in BOTH layers, matches the packet levelChart exactly, matches the mirror's recorded chart, and every why agrees with its side. 51.05% over 286 games fits a near-even lane with a Kled early edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked spike was called 'Repeating Dashes' — Ambessa has no such ability. Her Level 6 window is Public Execution, and no cooldown number appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Kit file lists Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). Public Execution is 130/115/100s and is what the whys already describe as 'her window' at 6.
audit.corrected: Every 'Repeating Dashes' occurrence replaced with Public Execution, and its 130s cooldown stated in dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: A fabricated ability name carried the entire interaction section, and the two real decisive mechanics were absent: Public Execution suppresses before it stuns, and Drakehound's Step is an auto-reset dash that fires AFTER the ability cast.
audit.why: Riot's R text: 'blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.' Suppression means no dash, Kled's E or R included, answers it once it starts. Riot's passive text: 'Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast' — so the tell is her ability wind-up, exactly as the missing-interactions entry says. Her R also carries a heal flag, which is the anti-heal trigger the missing-interactions file flags.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d states the suppress-then-stun and that no dash answers it; dontsFull[1].d states the Drakehound's Step wind-up tell; dontsFull[0].d ties Grievous Wounds to Public Execution.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Her mobility. Q-pull the follow-up.' named no ability and no duration.
audit.why: Public Execution 130s rank 1 is the punishable window; Repudiation is 18s and Lacerate 13s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 130s now stated in three places as the engage trigger.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability — it appeared in 18 fields as the matchup's tracked cooldown. Replaced everywhere with Public Execution, which is what the whys already describe as her Level 6 window. focus.text still reads 'Ambessa Repeating Dashes' but is 24 characters, under the applier's 25-char skip threshold, so it could not be repaired through a normal edit — it needs fixing directly by the applier or a tools pass. Her R carries a derived 'grounding' flag; Riot's text describes blink, suppression, slam and stun with no grounding, so no grounding claim was written (suppression already denies every dash). Also note she is female and several fields said 'he' — corrected in passing where the field was already being edited.
